title: Cleopatra Lived Closer to the Moon Landing 🚀 #Shorts
script: Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the construction of the Great Pyramid of Giza. The Great Pyramid was completed around twenty five sixty B C E, while Cleopatra lived in the first century B C E. Apollo eleven landed on the Moon in nineteen sixty nine. Ancient Egypt lasted for so long that events we group together were actually separated by enormous spans of time. Follow for more history facts.

scenes.sub: History can distort our sense of time.
It was already ancient to Cleopatra.
Closer to Cleopatra than the pyramid was.
